title: zazzle MCP proxy operations
description: `zazzled proxy`, in its two forms. `zazzle proxy ARGS` reaches it by exec (macos/c/zazzle); on Intel Macs, which have no invoker, it is run as `zazzled proxy` directly. Options shared by both: --lossless, --budget T (per text, default 8000), --skip TOOL (repeatable), --config FILE (per-tool settings), --log. A bad command line prints `zazzled: ...` with the usage and exits 2.

entities.name: zazzled proxy -- CMD ARGS
entities.description: Runs an MCP server over standard streams and cleans its answers.
entities.transport: zazzle proxy [--lossless] [--budget T] [--skip TOOL].. [--config FILE] [--log] -- CMD ARGS..; started by an MCP client as its stdio server
entities.authorization: Whoever starts it; the server command runs with the caller's environment and permissions. Nothing else is checked.
entities.result: Relays newline-delimited JSON-RPC between the client on standard input and output and the server child, cleaning the texts of tools/call and resources/read answers; the server's stderr passes through. Exits with the server's exit code when the server closes its output.
failures: No command after `--`, or `--` together with --upstream or --listen: usage error.
A --config file that cannot be read or is not valid: `zazzled: --config FILE: ...`, exit 2.
The server command cannot be started: `cannot start CMD: ...`, exit 2.

entities.name: zazzled proxy --upstream URL
entities.description: Serves Streamable HTTP on a local address and forwards each request to an upstream MCP endpoint, cleaning its answers.
entities.transport: zazzle proxy [--lossless] [--budget T] [--skip TOOL].. [--config FILE] [--log] --upstream URL [--listen ADDR]; clients connect over HTTP/1.1 to ADDR (default 127.0.0.1:8808)
entities.authorization: Any process that can reach the listen address; requests carrying an Origin header from a host other than localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1] are refused with 403. Authorization and session headers are forwarded to the upstream, which does its own checks.
entities.result: Prints `zazzled proxy: http://ADDR → URL` on standard error and serves until the listener fails, each connection on its own thread. A connection carries requests one after another, each answered with the upstream's status, redirects and end-to-end headers, until the client sends `Connection: close` (or speaks HTTP/1.0 without keep-alive), sends a request that cannot be read, or is idle for 60 seconds; an answer of unknown length is sent chunked while the connection stays open, and 1xx, 204 and 304 answers get no body.
failures: --upstream that is not an http:// or https:// URL, or a --config file that cannot be read or is not valid.
The listen address cannot be bound: `cannot listen on ADDR: ...`.

Per request: a head over 64 KiB (431), a malformed head or a body that ends early (400), a chunked body (411), a body over 64 MiB (413), each answered and the connection closed; another web origin (403) or an upstream that cannot be reached (502), after which a kept connection stays open.
